mapper.sql: id, project_id, identifier, name, class_name, description, category, version, tags_json, schema_json, raw_json, del_flag, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO yglue_flow_model (project_id, identifier, name, class_name, description, category, version, tags_json, schema_json, raw_json, del_flag) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{identifier}, #{name}, #{className}, #{description}, #{category}, #{version}, #{tagsJson}, #{schemaJson}, #{rawJson}, #{delFlag})
mapper.update: UPDATE yglue_flow_model SET name = #{name}, class_name = #{className}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, version = #{version}, tags_json = #{tagsJson}, schema_json = #{schemaJson}, raw_json = #{rawJson}, del_flag = #{delFlag}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM yglue_flow_model WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY name ASC
